name: AI Installed
who: Owners of 2–20 person businesses in and around Amersfoort who have tried ChatGPT, pay for it, and still run every quote, every follow-up and every enquiry by hand.
problem: "We know we should be doing something with AI. I have a subscription. Nobody here has time to work out what to actually do with it, and every consultant who calls wants to talk about strategy."
solution: In two weeks we install three working systems into the business: an assistant on the website that answers enquiries and books them in, a content pipeline that drafts the month's marketing, and one back-office automation — quotes, follow-ups or bookkeeping triage. Fixed price, fixed scope. Then a monthly care plan keeps them running and adds the next one.
promise: You have the ChatGPT subscription and nothing in your business actually runs on it. Three AI systems installed and working in two weeks — enquiry answering, marketing drafts, and one back-office job — for a fixed price, without anyone on your team learning a new tool.
gets:
An enquiry assistant on your website that answers in seconds and books the call
A monthly content pipeline that drafts your posts and emails from your own material
One back-office automation, built around how you already work, plus a care plan at €195/month
positioning: Every other AI offer in this market sells advice, a workshop or a subscription. This one leaves three things switched on and working, and is priced before it starts.
voice: Plain and specific. Names the task being automated, the price, and the day it goes live. Never the word 'transformation'.
channels: Local business associations, bedrijvenkring and BNI-style networks, LinkedIn to owners within 30km, referrals from accountants and bookkeepers
